title: The Inventory of the coast road
author: Emrys Zhou
blurb: Yara Amberdale, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
